# Zcash Mining Pools (Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ Bitcoin mu)

## Dɛn ne Zcash Mining Pools?

Zcash mining pools yɛ dwumadie a ɛma miners sɛ wɔ bɛtumi ayɔ wɔn computing tumi (hashrate). Ɛnam sika no so, nnipa bebree bɔ mmɔden ma ɛmu tɔ den na wonya akatua ketewa sen sɛ wɔbɛgyina ɔbodan mu.
